metadata.title: Gritty Monochrome Portrait with Hand-Lettered Header

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, grainy black-and-white close-up portrait featuring a subject with long hair and an intense gaze, topped with informal hand-lettered text.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast black-and-white photograph of a man's face, partially obscured by long, textured hair. The lighting is dramatic, emphasizing the bridge of the nose and one eye. Informal, all-caps hand-lettering is positioned across the top edge, appearing as if written directly onto the print.
coreVisualRelationships: Text overlaps the dark hair at the top edge
High contrast between deep shadows and bright highlights on the face
Grainy texture unifies the image and the lettering
Tight cropping focuses on the subject's intense expression

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is centered and fills approximately 80% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's right eye (viewer's right) is the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye leads to the bridge of the nose, then upward to the hand-lettered title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily in the dark shadows of the hair and background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for shadows and hair.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for facial highlights and text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin texture and hair detail.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast with a compressed mid-tone range.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width suggesting a felt-tip marker
characterSpecificRedesigns: E and F have elongated horizontal bars
Y has a deep, curved tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style hand-lettering to maintain a raw, personal aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the informal, raw energy of the original.
Provides a similar tactile quality if a font must be used.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy black-and-white close-up portrait of a man with long, messy hair, focusing on an intense gaze with dramatic lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of white, hand-lettered uppercase text across the top edge, ensuring it looks like it was written with a marker over the image.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture visible across the entire frame?
Does the text appear hand-drawn rather than typeset?

mustRedesign: Avoid using any specific celebrity likeness
Do not use existing brand logos
postGenerationChecks: Verify text is legible but informal
Ensure grain does not obscure facial features
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W portrait + heavy film grain + top-aligned marker lettering.
